sql: WITH inst AS ( SELECT id, instance_id, unit, provider, status, is_active, company_id FROM wapi_instances WHERE provider = 'evolution' OR company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' ) SELECT 'instancias' AS secao, to_jsonb(i) AS dados FROM inst i UNION ALL SELECT 'saude', jsonb_build_object('key', h.key, 'state', h.state, 'state_since', h.state_since, 'bad', h.bad_checks, 'alerted_state', h.alerted_state, 'alerted_at', h.alerted_at, 'last_check_at', h.last_check_at, 'detail', left(h.detail::text, 600)) FROM provider_health h UNION ALL SELECT 'incidentes', to_jsonb(pi) FROM provider_incidents pi WHERE pi.started_at >= '2026-10-15T00:00:00Z' OR pi.ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'cron_jobs', jsonb_build_object('jobid', j.jobid, 'schedule', j.schedule, 'active', j.active, 'cmd', left(j.command, 200)) FROM cron.job j WHERE j.command ILIKE '%evolution-monitor%' UNION ALL SELECT 'cron_runs', jsonb_build_object('hora_utc', date_trunc('hour', d.start_time), 'jobid', d.jobid, 'status', d.status, 'n', count(*)) FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.command ILIKE '%evolution-monitor%' AND d.start_time BETWEEN '2026-10-16T12:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', d.start_time), d.jobid, d.status UNION ALL SELECT 'eventos_resumo', jsonb_build_object('inst', e.instance_id, 'event', e.event_type, 'n', count(*), 'primeiro', min(e.received_at), 'ultimo', max(e.received_at), 'status', string_agg(DISTINCT e.processing_status, ',')) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events e WHERE e.received_at BETWEEN '2026-10-16T12:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' AND e.instance_id IN (SELECT instance_id FROM inst WHERE provider = 'evolution') GROUP BY e.instance_id, e.event_type
